001package org.clafer.ast.analysis;
002
003import java.util.HashMap;
004import java.util.Map;
005import org.clafer.ast.AstAbstractClafer;
006import org.clafer.ast.AstConcreteClafer;
007import org.clafer.ast.Card;
008
009/**
010 * Rewrites the model replacing unbounded high cardinalities with bounded
011 * effective high cardinalities.
012 *
013 * @author jimmy
014 */
015public class CardAnalyzer implements Analyzer {
016
017    @Override
018    public Analysis analyze(Analysis analysis) {
019        Map<AstConcreteClafer, Card> cardMap = new HashMap<>();
020        analyze(analysis.getModel().getAbstractRoot(), cardMap, analysis);
021        analyze(analysis.getModel().getRoot(), 1, cardMap, analysis);
022        return analysis.setCardMap(cardMap);
023    }
024
025    private static void analyze(AstAbstractClafer clafer, Map<AstConcreteClafer, Card> cardMap, Analysis analysis) {
026        Card globalCard = analysis.getGlobalCard(clafer);
027        for (AstAbstractClafer child : clafer.getAbstractChildren()) {
028            analyze(child, cardMap, analysis);
029        }
030        for (AstConcreteClafer child : clafer.getChildren()) {
031            analyze(child, globalCard.getLow(), cardMap, analysis);
032        }
033    }
034
035    private static void analyze(AstConcreteClafer clafer, int parentlowGlobalCard, Map<AstConcreteClafer, Card> cardMap, Analysis analysis) {
036        int low = analysis.getCard(clafer).getLow();
037        int high = analysis.getCard(clafer).getHigh();
038        Card globalCard = analysis.getGlobalCard(clafer);
039
040        int evenlyDistributed = parentlowGlobalCard * low;
041        int rest = globalCard.getHigh() - evenlyDistributed;
042        int scope = analysis.getScope(clafer);
043        int effectiveHigh = Math.min(scope, Math.min(high, low + rest));
044        // The scope cannot fit the lower cardinality, e.g. low > scope, or fewer
045        // instances than the parents need in a recursive structure.
046        if (low > effectiveHigh) {
047            cardMap.put(clafer, new Card(0, 0));
048        } else {
049            cardMap.put(clafer, new Card(low, effectiveHigh));
050        }
051
052        for (AstConcreteClafer child : clafer.getChildren()) {
053            analyze(child, globalCard.getLow(), cardMap, analysis);
054        }
055        for (AstAbstractClafer child : clafer.getAbstractChildren()) {
056            analyze(child, cardMap, analysis);
057        }
058    }
059}
